commit.message: Added a single description line to the SKILL.md frontmatter, summarizing the skill's read-only role in helping users inspect a pinned skill revision in Laomedo. All other bytes, including CRLF line endings, are preserved.
commit.patch:
--- base/SKILL.md
+++ draft/SKILL.md
@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
 ---\r\n
 name: claude-workspace-guide\r\n
+description: Helps a user understand a selected registered skill in Laomedo by inspecting its pinned revision, files, and commit diffs in a read-only way.\r\n
 ---\r\n
 \r\n
 # Inspect a skill workspace\r\n

verification_harness_error: Original assertion compared normalized read_text LF with exact registry CRLF and used an overescaped regex. Host operation was correct; its finally block stopped the runner before resume.
